audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows disagreed with the packet chart and with their own whys: Level 2 was Kennen while whys[1] says neither side lands cleanly, Level 6 was Skill while whys[4] calls his R the lane's biggest window, and 2+ items was Kennen while whys[6] says Poppy is a relentless engage he cannot poke down.
audit.why: The prose was already right; only the side tokens were wrong, so the page rendered two answers to the same question.
audit.corrected: Level 2 to Skill, Level 6 to Kennen, 2+ items to Poppy, in matched full/content pairs. Now identical to the audited kennen__poppy mirror.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly timed: levels 2-3, level 6 Slicing Maelstrom, first item Mercury's Treads, 2+ items tank window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's headline interaction is 'Lightning Rush (Dash) — your W disables it!', repeated in tldr, winCon, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull, report[0], report[1] and report[5]. Riot's description of Lightning Rush is a lightning form that passes through units and grants move speed — no dash anywhere, and the kit gives it no dash flag. Steadfast Presence stops dashes.
audit.why: The whole win condition was built on an interaction the data does not support, and a player would hold a 20s W for a parry that may never trigger.
audit.corrected: Every 'W disables his dash' claim replaced with what is verifiable: Lightning Rush is a 170-range form on 10/9/8/7/6s and 80 energy, so trade inside its cooldown. Added the real missing interaction — Kennen's third Mark of the Storm stuns, and that stun cancels Keeper's Verdict's channel, so never open R while he holds two marks on you.

audit.why: Electrical Surge applies on-hit and scales with attack speed, so armour alone misreads the trade; the page already makes MR and Mercury's Treads the core call.

edits.before: W deletes his dash mid-flight — hold it like a parry. Only take the trade when Kennen's Lightning Rush is down.
edits.after: Lightning Rush is a movement form, not a dash — 170 range, 80 energy. Take the trade inside its 10s rank-1 cooldown.

edits.before: Build MR — W-ground his E, E-wall-stun him. Poppy wins the Lightning Rush cooldown windows.
edits.after: Build MR — E-wall-stun him on the Lightning Rush cooldown, and never open R on two Marks.

edits.before: Build MR and ground his E. Track Lightning Rush before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Build MR and wall-stun him. Track Lightning Rush before every commit and keep the wave on your side.

edits.before: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — Dash escape — your W disables it! Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — his escape form, 10s at rank 1, not a dash. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: never channel it on two Marks.

edits.before: Dash escape — your W disables it! Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His escape form, up every 10s at rank 1. Engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Kennen wastes Lightning Rush (Dash) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Kennen burns Lightning Rush to escape — commit the full pattern now.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Three Marks stun you, and that stun cancels Keeper's Verdict.

edits.before: Build MR — W-ground his E, E-wall-stun him.
edits.after: Build MR, wall-stun him, respect three Marks.

edits.before: Build MR and ground his E. Track Lightning Rush before every commit.
edits.after: Build MR and wall-stun him. Track Lightning Rush before every commit.

edits.before: Track Kennen's Lightning Rush (Dash): Dash escape — your W disables it! When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Track Lightning Rush: his escape form, 10s at rank 1, and not a dash. When it is down — E-Q + R him.

edits.before: Your Steadfast armor/MR, max-HP Q, and W dash-deny make you a relentless engage on a squishy kiter — he can't poke down a tank or escape the grounding.
edits.after: Your Steadfast armor/MR, max-HP Q and Hammer Shock's slow zone make you a relentless engage on a squishy kiter — he can't poke down a tank that closes.

edits.before: Your max-HP Q and W dash-deny make you a reliable engage tool on him into the mid game — he can't kite a tank who chunks percent HP.
edits.after: Your max-HP Q and Steadfast Presence's resists make you a reliable engage on him by mid game — he can't kite a tank who chunks percent HP.

notes: dosFull[2].t is 'W-ground his E dash' (19 chars) — the applier skips strings under 25 characters, so the wrong title survives even though its description is now corrected. Same problem in dontsFull[2].t 'Waste W before his E'. Both need a champion-level fix outside this proposal. Deliberately NOT asserted, matching the kennen__poppy mirror note: whether Steadfast Presence stops Lightning Rush at all is absent from the data — Riot's text calls it a form with move speed and unit-collision bypass, and the kit tags it zone, not dash. I removed the claim rather than inverting it. The packet's suspectName 'Your Steadfast Presence' in the late text is a false positive; that is the correct ability name. Packet header also disagrees with itself on sample size — games 220 at top level, 172 inside the packet; I used it only as 'enough data to audit'.
